text:
Brazil mu wɔ 24 June kɔsi 16 July 1950, na ɛyɛ Wiase Kupu a edi kan a wɔyɛɛ no Ɛtoɔ Abien akyi, 1942 ne 1946 nkyerɛase no na wɔatwa mu. Nnipa 13 na wɔtoo mu wɔ agorɔ a ɛyɛ soronko: kuw anan a wɔde kɔɔ mu, ɛnyɛ knockout bracket na ɛyɛ final kuw anan round-robin pool, ɛma 1950 yɛ Wiase Kupu a wɔde round-robin final stage na ɛsi mu, ɛnyɛ single championship match. Ɛyɛ nso edition a edi kan a defending champions no wɔtwaa wɔn mu wɔ round a edi kan mu, sɛnea Italy kɔɔ mu ntem.

Ɔman a ɛyɛ host no baa final pool no mu wɔ tumi kɛse, wɔtwaa Sweden 7–1 ne Spain 6–1 na ɛyɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya abodin no. Brazil hia draw pɛ wɔ agorɔ a ɛyɛ decisive no mu ne Uruguay sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ abodin no. Wɔ 16 July, wɔ Estádio do Maracanã a wɔabɔ foforɔ wɔ Rio de Janeiro, nnipa 173,850 a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din no na wɔbaa mu wɔ agorɔ a ɛyɛ football agorɔ a wɔanya attendance kɛse wɔ mu; total tournament attendance no kɔɔ one million.

Brazil de Friça dii kan wɔ second half no mu, nanso Uruguay ammpɛ sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho. Schiaffino yɛɛ equalise wɔ 66th minute na Ghiggia bɔɔ winner no wɔ 79th, agorɔ no wiee 2–1 wɔ regular time mu, ɛnyɛ extra time anaa penalties. Nsɛm no, a wɔde too Maracanã mu wɔ nna a ɛyɛ silent, bɛyɛɛ 'Maracanazo' na ɛyɛ football mu upset kɛse no mu biako.

Uruguay yɛɛ champions ne mprenu, mfe 20 akyi wɔ wɔn nkunim wɔ 1930. Brazil dii akyi na Sweden dii mprenu. Brazil Ademir na ɔyɛ top scorer wɔ tournament no mu wɔ goɔl 9. Nni official best-player anaa Golden Ball award wɔ saa edition yi mu, enti obiara nni abasobɔdeɛ.
